{"config":{"theme":"base","layout":"elk","look":"handDrawn","flowchart":{"curve":"step","htmlLabels":true},"themeVariables":{"fontFamily":"system-ui, sans-serif","fontSize":"14px","lineColor":"#313131"},"elk":{"mergeEdges":false,"nodePlacementStrategy":"BRANDES_KOEPF"}}}
---
flowchart BT
  classDef core fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef supporting fill:#c6dcff,stroke:#305bab,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef generic fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef focus stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  classDef aggregate fill:#ffffff,stroke:#6b6b6b,color:#1a1a1a
  subgraph catalog["Catalog"]
    subgraph browsing["Browsing"]
      browsing__Session["Session"]:::aggregate
    end
    style browsing fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
    search["Search"]:::core
  end
  style catalog fill:#f7f7ff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  subgraph orders["Orders"]
    subgraph checkout["Checkout"]
      checkout__Order["Order"]:::aggregate
      checkout__Cart["Cart"]:::aggregate
    end
    style checkout fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a,stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  end
  style orders fill:#ffffff,stroke:#b0b0b0
  subgraph foundations["Shared Foundations"]
    subgraph identity["Identity"]
      identity__Account["Account"]:::aggregate
      identity__Identity["Identity"]:::aggregate
    end
    style identity fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
    subgraph payments["Payments"]
      payments__Payment["Payment"]:::aggregate
    end
    style payments fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  end
  style foundations fill:#eaf9ef,stroke:#067429,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#1a1a1a
  checkout -.-> catalog
  checkout <--> catalog
  checkout --- search
  checkout__Order --> identity__Account
  checkout__Order --> identity__Identity
  checkout__Order --> payments__Payment
  checkout__Cart --> checkout__Order
  checkout__Cart --> browsing__Session
  linkStyle 0 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:3 3
  linkStyle 1 interpolate step stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px
  linkStyle 2 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  linkStyle 3,4,5,6,7 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  %% violations: 1
  %% roles: 3=OHS,PL>ACL;5=S>C
  click search href "#level=aggregate&focus=search&display.foundations=expanded"
  click browsing__Session href "#level=aggregate&focus=browsing&display.foundations=expanded"
  click checkout__Order href "#level=aggregate&focus=checkout&display.foundations=expanded"
  click checkout__Cart href "#level=aggregate&focus=checkout&display.foundations=expanded"
  click identity__Account href "#level=aggregate&focus=identity&display.foundations=expanded"
  click identity__Identity href "#level=aggregate&focus=identity&display.foundations=expanded"
  click payments__Payment href "#level=aggregate&focus=payments&display.foundations=expanded"

{"config":{"theme":"base","layout":"elk","look":"handDrawn","flowchart":{"curve":"step","htmlLabels":true},"themeVariables":{"fontFamily":"system-ui, sans-serif","fontSize":"14px","lineColor":"#313131"},"elk":{"mergeEdges":false,"nodePlacementStrategy":"BRANDES_KOEPF"}}}
---
flowchart BT
  classDef core fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef supporting fill:#c6dcff,stroke:#305bab,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef generic fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  classDef focus stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  classDef aggregate fill:#ffffff,stroke:#6b6b6b,color:#1a1a1a
  subgraph catalog["Catalog"]
    subgraph browsing["Browsing"]
      browsing__Session["Session"]:::aggregate
    end
    style browsing fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
    search["Search"]:::core
  end
  style catalog fill:#f7f7ff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a
  subgraph orders["Orders"]
    subgraph checkout["Checkout"]
      checkout__Order["Order"]:::aggregate
      checkout__Cart["Cart"]:::aggregate
    end
    style checkout fill:#dedaff,stroke:#6631d7,color:#1a1a1a,stroke-width:4px,font-weight:bold
  end
  style orders fill:#ffffff,stroke:#b0b0b0
  subgraph foundations["Shared Foundations"]
    subgraph identity["Identity"]
      identity__Account["Account"]:::aggregate
      identity__Identity["Identity"]:::aggregate
    end
    style identity fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
    subgraph payments["Payments"]
      payments__Payment["Payment"]:::aggregate
    end
    style payments fill:#adf0c7,stroke:#067429,color:#1a1a1a
  end
  style foundations fill:#eaf9ef,stroke:#067429,stroke-dasharray:4 3,color:#1a1a1a
  checkout -.-> catalog
  checkout <--> catalog
  checkout --- search
  checkout__Order --> identity__Account
  checkout__Order --> identity__Identity
  checkout__Order --> payments__Payment
  checkout__Cart --> checkout__Order
  checkout__Cart --> browsing__Session
  linkStyle 0 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:3 3
  linkStyle 1 interpolate step stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px
  linkStyle 2 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  linkStyle 3,4,5,6,7 interpolate step stroke:#313131,stroke-width:1.5px
  %% violations: 1
  %% roles: 3=OHS,PL>ACL;5=S>C
  click search href "#level=aggregate&focus=search&display.foundations=expanded"
  click browsing__Session href "#level=aggregate&focus=browsing&display.foundations=expanded"
  click checkout__Order href "#level=aggregate&focus=checkout&display.foundations=expanded"
  click checkout__Cart href "#level=aggregate&focus=checkout&display.foundations=expanded"
  click identity__Account href "#level=aggregate&focus=identity&display.foundations=expanded"
  click identity__Identity href "#level=aggregate&focus=identity&display.foundations=expanded"
  click payments__Payment href "#level=aggregate&focus=payments&display.foundations=expanded"
